summary: Tested new Tax Alerts + Bank->Expenses sync features. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed against public URL. Frontend: /analise-bancaria loads with 'ALERTAS FISCAIS' panel (data-testid=tax-alerts-panel) showing PT fiscal deadlines (IVA 2.º Trim 2026 15/08 em 8 dias, TSU/IRS 20/08 em 13 dias, TSU Sep, PPC 30/09). Analysis detail page shows 'Sincronizar com Despesas' button (data-testid=sync-expenses-btn); click yields result panel 'Resultado da sincronização: 0 criadas / 20 duplicados ignorados' with expandable 'Ver duplicados ignorados (20)'. Toast informs 'Nenhuma nova despesa. 20 duplicados detectados.' Idempotency confirmed via API (second sync returns created=0, skipped=total_processed). Expenses persisted with bank_txn_id, correct payment_method='Transferência Bancária' and all required fields.
critical_code_review_comments: bank_analysis.py get_tax_alerts uses today.strftime('%B %Y') which yields English month names (e.g. 'August 2026') — consider PT localization for consistency with UI (currently mixes 'IVA 2.º Trimestre' PT + 'TSU August 2026' EN).
Duplicate fuzzy key uses only first 20 chars of supplier — may cause false positives for suppliers sharing prefix. Consider tighter matching (e.g. normalize + first 30 chars, or add invoice_number).

TSU/IRS deadlines are only generated for current month + next month; if today > 20, current month entry becomes overdue window (<=-5 days) and drops off; consider always including next 2 months explicitly.
seed_data_creation: No new seed. Reused existing 3 bank_analyses + 20 previously-synced expenses from iteration 34.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tax alerts + bank-to-expenses sync validated end-to-end (backend 7 tests + UI). Bank analysis list route is GET /api/bank-analysis (no trailing slash — 307 redirect otherwise). Detail page opens via clicking [data-testid^='analysis-<id>'] rows on /analise-bancaria.
